posts.body:
All the newer Maniacs versions are rewrites of the engine, not just modifications. So BingShan probably used some other method of storing these things than how we used to it - it's something you should ask on their Discord perhaps:

Also please keep in mind editing the KADOKAWA logo is not allowed as per patch EULA (you are not allowed to modify or remove copyright marks). You can change the EXFONT though.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
utunnels said:
Not sure if ttc works. People normally use ttf and otf. There is no need to renamed you just need to open and check their font names.
Click to expand...
You are talking about Maniacs, because Rm2k and Rm2k3 do not accept OTF fonts or the use of multiple fonts, only the standard RM2000 and RMG2000 fonts, which in this case:
Rm2k - Are compiled with the executable
Rm2k3 - Are compiled with the DLL
Furthermore, the requester is talking about EXFont, which are Glyphs (BMP):
Steam Community ::  :: Glyph comparison
Steam Community: RPG Maker 2003. Comparing the glyphs in RM2k3 between fonts.
steamcommunity.com
Examples of modified Exfont:
https://twitter.com/i/web/status/1812216407381151876

Renaming fonts does not change their real name, which is internal as far as I remember. Furthermore, if you are using Maniacs, the community cannot help you because the methods may be different, as Cherry has already warned in this same topic.
Also, as far as I know, Georgia is TTF and not TTC, so if you are using Rm2k or Rm2k3 (Steam) this won't work.
I don't know and I'm not going to study Maniacs to help you, follow the link that Cherry indicated for the Discord channel to receive support for this request.
Good luck
